_about: One reading per measurement across sources (docs/44 'Data' rule 5, the rank rule): a reading from another source
within 'window_s' (either way) of a stored one is the same measurement. The higher 'rank' (first = highest) wins:
a lower-ranked stored reading is removed when the higher one arrives, a lower-ranked incoming reading is dropped.
Equal ranks: what is stored first stays (relay and nearby carry the same reading). The same source at the same
time replaces its own reading (a re-send). 'readingRank' maps every reading source id to its rank; imported history
(Import history) is the lowest, as its own rule already says (the sensor wins). 'cases': 'stored' then 'incoming'
(each [seconds, source, mg/dL]; one batch) -> 'kept', sorted by time then source.
